def zero_shot(doc_vectors, label_vectors, names):
    guesses = []
    for d in doc_vectors:
        scores = [sum(a * b for a, b in zip(d, v)) for v in label_vectors]
        guesses.append(names[scores.index(max(scores))])
    return guesses
